plan.summary: BRO-6697: correct stored opening dates later than their review cluster. An American in Paris West End (Wikipedia: previews 2017-03-04, press night 2017-03-21), Pen Pals off-Broadway (Playbill: previews 2024-12-05, opened 2024-12-11), and three review-seeded regional rows whose earlier reviews sit only in review-texts (Little Shop Crucible, Sister Act Mercury, Brigadoon MTW) moved to their earliest review. The other ten theatreinchicago rows move via the daily reconcile (code change in this commit); Silver Manhattan is acked (official opening really was 2026-03-04, critics reviewed in previews).
